description: This file defines safe numeric conversion utilities, including range checking, casting, saturation, and range enforcement for numeric types. It provides templates and classes for compile-time and runtime safety in numeric conversions, with specializations for performance optimization.

classes.name: SaturationDefaultLimits
classes.description: Provides default limits for numeric types, including max, min, infinity, and NaN values.

classes.name: SaturateFastOp
classes.description: Template for fast saturation operations, specialized for integral types.

classes.name: StrictNumeric
classes.description: Template class for compile-time range-checked numeric types, ensuring safe conversions and assignments.

methods.name: checked_cast
methods.description: Performs a checked cast between numeric types, ensuring no overflow or underflow.

methods.name: saturated_cast
methods.description: Performs a cast that saturates at numeric limits instead of overflowing.

methods.name: strict_cast
methods.description: Performs a static cast with compile-time range validation.

methods.name: MakeStrictNum
methods.description: Creates a StrictNumeric wrapper from a numeric value.
